Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 951 of 2018

Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1. List revised.
2. Ms. Punita Pandey, learned counsel for the revisionist and Sri Bade Lal Bind, learned counsel for the State is present, who has been heard.

3. The present revision has been filed by the revisionist- Ram Kumar Singh, against the judgement and order dated 17.02.2018 passed by Addl. Sessions Judge / F.T.C. (First), Amroha in Criminal Appeal No. 37 of 2015 (Ram Kumar Singh Vs. State of U.P.) arising out of impugned judgement and order dated 06.06.2015 passed by the C.J.M., J.P. 1 of U.P. Vs. Ram Kumar Singh), under Section 7(1)/16(1)(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, P.S.- Naugawana Sadaat, District Amroha.
4.

sentences.text: As per office report dated 13.02.2024, a report from C.J.M. concerned was called for regarding living status of the revisionist in present revision.
In compliance of the said order, C.J.M. concerned vide letter dated 20.12.2023 informed that the revisionist- Ram Kumar Singh has died.
The said report has been sent after due enquiry.
6. The trial court records, if received, be sent back along with the communication of this order.
Office to communicate this order to District and Sessions Judge concerned within two weeks from today.
